scope: Educational numeric tools only; outputs are not diagnostic or treatment recommendations.

calculators.name: Mean Arterial Pressure (approx.)
calculators.description: Approximates mean arterial pressure from systolic and diastolic pressure.
calculators.source_label: NCBI Bookshelf — Physiology, Mean Arterial Pressure
calculators.note: Common approximation; the relationship can vary with heart rate and waveform shape. No clinical interpretation is provided.

calculators.name: Pulse Pressure
calculators.description: Calculates the arithmetic difference between systolic and diastolic pressure.
calculators.note: Arithmetic calculation only; no clinical interpretation is provided.

calculators.name: Temperature Conversion
calculators.description: Converts temperature between Celsius and Fahrenheit.

calculators.name: Cardiac Output (physiology formula)
calculators.description: Multiplies heart rate by stroke volume to illustrate the basic cardiac-output relationship.
calculators.note: Educational physiology formula only; no clinical interpretation or treatment recommendation is provided.

calculators.name: Minute Ventilation (physiology formula)
calculators.description: Multiplies respiratory rate by tidal volume to illustrate total air moved per minute.
calculators.note: Educational physiology formula only; no diagnosis or treatment interpretation is provided.

calculators.name: Cardiac Cycle Duration
calculators.description: Converts heart rate to the approximate duration of one cardiac cycle.
calculators.note: Educational arithmetic only; no clinical interpretation is provided.

calculators.name: Respiratory Cycle Duration
calculators.description: Converts respiratory rate to the approximate duration of one breathing cycle.
calculators.note: Educational arithmetic only; no clinical interpretation is provided.
